title: Marble Rush, floating 3D dot-eater maze in space... maybe me 22nd game or so.
author: couldgiveaflyingfck
selftext:
17 Prompts -

You roll a blue glass marble around a floating maze out in space, picking up glowing yellow dice. Four enemy marbles are out hunting you and they each have their own way of coming after you, so you can't just run in circles. Grab a gold power die and it flips around... now you get to ram them right off the edge.

The mazes have a few levels to them with ramps, bridges, tunnels, warp rings and spots where you can drop through to the deck below. There's boost rings, sling rings that fling you across to another deck, and a sealed vault you can crack open if you find the shards. I also built a level editor and a random board generator into it so it doesn't get stale.

Got four worlds so far, Slate Grid, Foundry, Glacier and Magma. Runs 120 fps in HDR on my OLED, clip is 60 though.

Still a work in progress so be honest. Good, bad, or "why does the red one always find me"... I want to hear it.

Does have an level editor with and a lot more coming soon.
